value.role: used Russia-based companies to employ North Korean IT workers

sources.locator: Asatryan IT Worker Network, opening sentence
sources.quote: Gayk Asatryan (Asatryan), a Russian national, has used his Russia-based companies to employ North Korean IT workers.

notes: Treasury sanctions finding; not a criminal charge or conviction.

sources.locator: Asatryan IT Worker Network, first contract sentence
sources.quote: In mid-2024, Asatryan signed a 10-year contract with a DPRK company, Korea Songkwang Trading General Corporation (Songkwang Trading), to dispatch up to 30 DPRK IT workers to work in Russia for his company, Asatryan Limited Liability Company (Asatryan LLC).

notes: Treasury-reported contract and planned worker deployment, retained as source-explicit incident context rather than a criminal adjudication or proof that deployment was completed.

The contract chronology, term, maximum worker count, counterparties, recipient company, and destination are public sanctions findings; no worker identities, client data, operational selectors, or present activity are inferred.

sources.locator: Asatryan IT Worker Network, second contract sentence
sources.quote: Asatryan also signed a contract with DPRK company Korea Saenal Trading Corporation (Saenal Trading), in which they planned to dispatch 50 DPRK IT workers to Russia for his company, Fortuna Limited Liability Company (Fortuna LLC).

notes: Treasury describes a plan; completion of the deployment was not independently established.

value.basis: attempted to engage in, facilitate, or be responsible for exportation of workers from North Korea

sources.locator: Asatryan IT Worker Network, designation sentence
sources.quote: OFAC designated Asatryan pursuant to E.O. 13722 for having attempted to engage in, facilitate, or be responsible for the exportation of workers from North Korea, including exportation to generate revenue for the Government of North Korea or Workers’ Party of Korea.

notes: Administrative sanctions designation, not a criminal adjudication.

identity_boundary: Gayk Asatryan, also listed by OFAC as Gaik Asatryan and Gayk Vanushevich Asatryan, is OFAC entity 53824 and the person Treasury links to Asatryan LLC and Fortuna LLC. The record carries an administrative designation and Treasury-reported conduct; criminal case status is outside this record. The RBC registry-mirror role is bridged through the exact Asatryan LLC registration record and corroborates only company identity and filing facts. Unrelated same-name people stay separate, and present residence is beyond the cited evidence.
